title: Amazon EventBridge to AWS Batch
description: Create an EventBridge event bus and route events to AWS Batch.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The AWS SAM template deploys the resources and the IAM permissions required to run the application.

The EventBridge rule specified in `template.yaml` filters the events based upon the criteria in the `EventPattern` section. When matching events are sent to EventBridge that trigger the rule, it triggers AWS Batch.
